title: Kohl’s jumps 4% in premarket as one-off gains inflate profit outlook
summary: Investing.com -- Kohl’s shares jumped over 4% in premarket trading on Tuesday after the department-store chain lifted its full-year profit forecast to $4.30-$4.50 a share, roughly double Wall Street’s $2.14 estimate, though about $2.60 of that comes from one-time tax, tariff-refund and real-estate gains.

summary: Uber Technologies (NYSE:UBER) has added retail delivery partnerships with Kohl's Corporation and AutoParts.com to its U.S. app-based marketplace. The company has agreed a new collaboration with Kijiji in Canada to handle delivery of secondhand goods listed on the classifieds platform. These arrangements extend Uber's delivery offering beyond food and groceries into categories such as apparel, home goods, auto parts, and resale items.
